work.title: Hyperkomplexe Grössen und Darstellungstheorie in arithmetischer Auffassung
work.author: Emmy Noether

lane.scope_note: Controlled Traditional-script derivative only; no Taiwan, Hong Kong, or Macao localization.

concept.preferred_gloss: controlled non-locale-specific Traditional Chinese script derivative
concept.intended_sense: A script-controlled derivative of the audited zh-Hans-CN target, preserving all mathematical and structural spans without claiming regional prose standardization.

candidates.form: OpenCC s2t plus controlled 為 / 群 / 裡 / 個 variants

candidates.definition_or_gloss: requires independent Taiwan evidence and review
requires independent local evidence and review

adverse.context_window: Mechanical conversion changes script but cannot establish regional idiom or terminology.

weight_semantics.notes: Adverse to localization claims, not to controlled script use.

absence.notes: No Hong Kong or Macao evidence.

sense.notes: Hans terminology decisions are inherited by script conversion rather than independently re-evidenced.

false_friend.notes: Handled in the Hans terminology record.

homograph.notes: Handled in the Hans terminology record.

dominance.notes: The underlying evidence is Mandarin Simplified; no regional Traditional cohort is represented.

register.notes: Traditional-script typography is controlled; regional prose register is not.

script.notes: Script conversion is internally auditable but not a localization method.

source_scarcity.notes: No independent regional Hant source was found.

source_floor.evidence_or_reason: The sealed German source and audited Hans target are frozen inputs.

context_review.evidence_or_reason: Script differences and controlled variants are explicitly delimited.

script_policy.evidence_or_reason: Output is labelled zh-Hant-controlled and non-localized.

internal_qa.evidence_or_reason: All 26 inline math spans and both display matrices match Hans; two final builds pass; both final pages were individually inspected after orphan repair.

decision.rationale: A controlled script derivative is useful and auditable when its limits are explicit; the missing regional evidence prohibits localization claims.
decision.reviewer_question: Which lexical and prose choices require change for separately evidenced Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macao editions?
decision.decision_authority: Chinese Noether production lane internal script audit

invariants.test: sequence-compare Hans and Hant math spans

invariants.may_change: only after independent regional evidence and review

provenance.notes: OpenCC 0.1.7 s2t followed by controlled normalization of 為 / 群 / 裡 / 個; no regional certification.
